description: This file implements the SqlStatusStore struct and its methods for managing user status data in a database, including CRUD operations, bulk updates, and status expiration handling within the Mattermost server.

classes.name: SqlStatusStore
classes.description: Struct for managing user status data in the database, including methods for CRUD operations and status management.

methods.name: newSqlStatusStore
methods.description: Initializes a new SqlStatusStore with a given SqlStore.

methods.name: SaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Inserts or updates a user status record in the database.

methods.name: SaveOrUpdateMany
methods.description: Bulk inserts or updates multiple user status records.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a user status by user ID.

methods.name: GetByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple user statuses by a list of user IDs.

methods.name: UpdateExpiredDNDStatuses
methods.description: Updates statuses that have expired DND (Do Not Disturb) time, resetting their status.

methods.name: ResetAll
methods.description: Resets all non-manual statuses to offline.

methods.name: GetTotalActiveUsersCount
methods.description: Counts the number of users active within the last 24 hours.

methods.name: UpdateLastActivityAt
methods.description: Updates the last activity timestamp for a user.
